legal_confidentialite_intro: This page explains what data Slogodle collects and how it is used.
legal_confidentialite_local_body: Your theme, sound and game-progress preferences are stored only in your browser's local storage. They never leave your device unless you create an account.
legal_confidentialite_account_body: If you create an account (email/password or GitHub sign-in), your email, username and game stats are stored in a Cloudflare database so your progress can sync across devices.
legal_confidentialite_hosting_body: Slogodle runs on Cloudflare's infrastructure, which may process technical data such as IP addresses to serve the site. No advertising or analytics trackers are used.
legal_confidentialite_rights_body: You can request access to, or deletion of, your account data at any time through the contact details on slocaly.dev.
